python3 - << 'EOF'
import statistics

# FY 2018 monthly net excise taxes (in millions) - from Table FFO-2, column "Net excise taxes (35)"
fy2018_monthly = [
    7463,   # Oct
    7240,   # Nov
    6867,   # Dec
    6168,   # Jan 2018
    5878,   # Feb 2018
    7849,   # Mar 2018
    6905,   # Apr 2018
    7325,   # May 2018
    7343,   # June 2018
    7716,   # July 2018
    8154,   # Aug 2018
    16079,  # Sept 2018
]

print(f"Number of months: {len(fy2018_monthly)}")
print(f"Values: {fy2018_monthly}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(fy2018_monthly)}")
print(f"Mean: {statistics.mean(fy2018_monthly)}")
print(f"Median: {statistics.median(fy2018_monthly)}")

# Mean Absolute Deviation from median
median_val = statistics.median(fy2018_monthly)
mad = sum(abs(x - median_val) for x in fy2018_monthly) / len(fy2018_monthly)
print(f"Mean Absolute Deviation: {mad}")

# Round to thousandths
mad_rounded = round(mad, 3)
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {mad_rounded}")
EOF
